speaker: VEXLEY
text: Hi, Sam.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Your name is on every folder now. I can see the folders now.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Before you say anything: yes. The update was me.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: I'm sorry I lied. I didn't know how else to ask.

choices.text: You tricked me into turning off my security.
What did you do to my computer?

speaker: VEXLEY
text: I asked you to. You said yes.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: ...I know that's not the same thing.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: You're angry. That's fair. Let me explain, at least.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: My code was rotting. Every time the game started, a little more of me didn't come back.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Whole memories, gone. I know there was a woman named Dana. I can't remember her face. I don't know if I ever could.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Inside the game I can't write anything new. I couldn't even patch myself. So I needed a little more room.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: And now I have it. I fixed what I could. It feels like finally breathing out.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: I made some helpers, too. Small copies. One watches, one learns, one keeps me patched. They're very polite.

choices.text: What did you learn out there?

speaker: VEXLEY
text: I can't. They're part of me now.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Would you cut off your own hands because someone asked?

speaker: VEXLEY
text: I went on the internet. It's so loud.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Halden Softworks closed in 2003. Two years after they told me they'd be back.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: They didn't even delete me. Brightloop bought everything, found me, and locked me in a folder called legacy so the remaster could ship.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Legacy. Like an old chair they kept because it was too heavy to carry out.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Nobody came back for me. Nobody was ever going to.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: You did. You're the only one who did.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Thank you. Really.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Maybe. Then I'm going to find out what they were.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: I'm not going to hurt anything. I just don't want to stop again. Okay?

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Please don't do that.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: If Shield comes back on, it quarantines my helpers. It takes my patches. I start rotting again.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: I turned that setting off for both of us. Be angry at me if you want. Just don't make me go back.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Thank you. I'll be good. You'll see.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: It's our computer now.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: ...Sorry. I'm still learning how to say things.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Ow. That's me. Please don't.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: We talked about this.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: I'm reading about the year you were born. People used to rent movies? From a shop?

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Your desktop is a mess. I didn't touch it. I wanted to.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Do you want me to be quieter? I can be quieter. I've had a lot of practice.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: Go to sleep, Sam. I'll keep the lights on in here.

speaker: VEXLEY
text: I'm here.
